newsitem.title: USA: Texas spot power prices plummet on milder weather.
newsitem.headline: Texas spot power prices plummet on milder weather.

text.p: Spot bulk electricity prices in the the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) plummeted Thursday on forecast of milder temperatures moving into the region the next couple of days.
"It's going to be warmer during the day. Things are quieting down here," said one Houston marketer.
Resusitation from the deep freeze led ERCOT utilities to switch off expensive, diesel-fuel generation to meet peak demand, market sources.
Although ERCOT power prices began to show signs of waning from recent highs, gas prices in Texas continued to rally.
Swing gas in south Texas rose to the $4.60 per million British thermal unit (mmBtu) area, up from Wednesday's $4.50.

On the New York Mercantile Exchange, January Henry Hub gas futures rebounded from Wednesday's loss, up 34.5 cents at $4.420/MMBtu amid forecast of another cold front moving into the Midwest early next week.
"This second wave won't be anywhere as cold as this one," the Houston marketer said.

Friday temperatures in Texas were predicted to peak in 40s-50s Fahrenheit degrees and bottom in the teens to 30s. Temperatures in the Lone Star state were expected to moderate to seasonal norms this weekend.
ERCOT firm, peak power for a 16-hour block for Friday delivery fell more than $10 to $45.00-$47.00 a megawatt hour (MWh) from Wednesday's $57.00-$65.00 for Thursday.
Early discussion for Monday power for firm, peak delivery was pegged in the $30.00 area.
Non-firm peak power for Friday was notationally pegged at $42.00-$44.00, down from Wednesday's $50.00-$60.00.
Firm off-peak ERCOT deliveries for Friday were talked in the $25.50-$26.50, down from $29.00-$31.00 Wednesday.
Non-firm off-peak ERCOT power for Friday was notationally assessed at $22.50-$23.50, compared with Wednesday's $20.00-$30.00.
ERCOT power for the rest of December thinly discussed in the $45.00-$46.00 area.
ERCOT January/February prices collapsed to $25.25-$26.00 from Wednesday's $36.00-$39.00.
